But reported growth is still thin (Q3 sales +1% YoY, Industrial Automation declined), the balance sheet is mid-deleveraging, and at $221.15 the stock is ~26x the raised EPS guide with the spin transition not yet fully proven.
HON.what_changes: A Q4 print delivering the guided ~22% margin with leverage below 3x and Industrial Automation returning to growth would lift quality/risk toward BUY; a guidance trim would confirm the transition discount.
